items.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of cybersecurity platform provider Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ:PANW) jumped 12% in the afternoon session after peer cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike reported stronger-than-expected quarterly financial results, lifting investor sentiment across the cybersecurity sector.

items.title: CrowdStrike vs. Okta: Which Cybersecurity Stock Is the Better Buy After Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: Cybersecurity stocks surged on Thursday after CrowdStrike (CRWD) and Okta (OKTA) both topped Q2 expectations yesterday evening and raised their outlooks.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks’ Platform Strategy Supports a Bullish Q4 Outlook
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks is increasingly using its platform strategy to deepen customer relationships and capture a larger share of enterprise security spending.

items.title: SNPS Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on EDA and Ansys Strength
items.summary: Synopsys beats Q3 estimates as EDA and Ansys fuel strong growth, while higher margins and an upgraded fiscal 2026 outlook add momentum.

items.title: CRWD Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on ARR and Falcon Flex Strength
items.summary: CrowdStrike beats Q2 estimates as record net new ARR, Falcon Flex adoption and AI-security demand drive growth and a higher fiscal 2027 outlook.

items.title: NVIDIA Q2 Earnings Beat on Blackwell Ultra & Data Center Strength
items.summary: NVDA's Q2 results top expectations as Blackwell Ultra fuels record Data Center growth, while Vera Rubin is set to gain prominence in Q3.

items.title: Why Palo Alto Networks Stock Just Popped
items.summary: Palo Alto stock tries to roll up the AI cybersecurity industry and buy out its competition.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks’ CEO Says Nebius Is in a Different League. Is This ‘Neoscaler’ a Buy?
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks' CEO is warning that most AI cloud companies will collapse when GPU scarcity ends, but he carves out a narrow exception for a category of survivors he calls neoscalers. Nebius made his list, and the reasons why change the calculus entirely for investors watching the AI infrastructure boom.
